cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(FileVeilRegistryArchiveProject VERSION 1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)
find_package(ZLIB REQUIRED)
find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/dist")
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELEASE "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/dist")
add_library(fvcodec STATIC codec.cpp io.cpp)
target_link_libraries(fvcodec PUBLIC ZLIB::ZLIB)
add_executable(fvpack pack.cpp)
target_link_libraries(fvpack PRIVATE fvcodec)
add_executable(fvchecksum checksum.c)
target_link_libraries(fvchecksum PRIVATE ZLIB::ZLIB)
enable_testing()
foreach(kind empty text binary corrupt)
  add_test(NAME archive_${kind} COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}"
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/roundtrip.py" "$<TARGET_FILE:fvpack>" "$<TARGET_FILE:fvchecksum>" ${kind})
endforeach()
